"end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Shortcut Trick\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Profit Ratio of A, B and C = (10 × 5) : (12 × 6) : (15 × 9) = 50 : 72 : 135

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Total profit in ratio parts = 50 + 72 + 135 = 257 parts

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Given A's profit = 50 parts = Rs. 2500 ⇒ 1 part = Rs. 50

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Total Profit = 257 parts = 257 × 50 = Rs. 12,850

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ∴ The correct answer is Rs. 12,850.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Alternate Method

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Investment of A = Rs. 10,000, Time = 5 months

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Investment of B = Rs. 12,000, Time = 6 months

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Investment of C = Rs. 15,000, Time = 9 months

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            A's profit share = Rs. 2,500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Formula Used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Profit Ratio = Investment × Time

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Calculations:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ Profit ratio (A : B : C) = (10000 × 5) : (12000 × 6) : (15000 × 9)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ Profit ratio = 50000 : 72000 : 135000 = 50 : 72 : 135

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ Let the profits of A, B, and C be 50x, 72x, and 135x respectively.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ Total profit = 50x + 72x + 135x = 257x

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ Given A's profit = 50x = 2500

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ x = 2500 ÷ 50 = 50

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ⇒ Total Profit = 257x = 257 × 50 = 12850

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ∴ The correct answer is Rs. 12,850.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Compound Partnership

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            When capitals of partners are invested for different time periods, the profit or loss is distributed in the ratio of the product of their capital and time.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Simple Partnership

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            When capitals of partners are invested for the same period of time, the profit or loss is distributed in the exact ratio of their original investments.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Working and Sleeping Partners

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            A working partner manages the business and receives a specific salary or percentage. A sleeping partner only invests capital. The remaining profit after salary deduction is shared in the investment ratio.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            दिया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            निवेशित राशि,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            A द्वारा = 10,000 रुपये 5 महीने के लिए

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            B द्वारा = 12,000 रुपये 6 महीने के लिए

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            C द्वारा = 15,000 रुपये 9 महीने के लिए

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            प्रयुक्त अवधारणा:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            लाभ प्रतिशत = \\({profit\\over invested}×100\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            A का लाभ प्रतिशत = \\({2500\\over10000}×100\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       = 25%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            25% लाभ 5 महीने के लिए है,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            लाभ प्रति माह = \\({25\\over5}\\)%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                = 5%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            यह लाभ प्रतिशत सभी निवेशकों के लिए है

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            6 महीने के लिए B का लाभ प्रतिशत = 6 x 5 % 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      = 30%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            B की लाभ राशि = 12000 का 30%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   = \\({30\\over100}×12000\\) 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   = 3600 रुपये

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            9 महीने के लिए C का लाभ प्रतिशत = 9 × 5%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       = 45%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            C की लाभ राशि = \\({45\\over100}×15000\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   = 6750 रुपये

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            कुल लाभ राशि = 2500+ 3600 + 6750

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 = 12,850 रुपये

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            कुल लाभ 12,850 है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            B= రూ. 12,000 6 నెలల పాటు

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            C= రూ. 15,000 9 నెలల పాటు

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              = 25%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            25% లాభం 5 నెలలకు,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            నెలకు లాభం = \\({25\\over5}\\) %

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   = 5%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            పెట్టుబడిదారులందరికీ ఈ లాభాల శాతం ఉంటుంది

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            B యొక్క లాభం శాతం 6 నెలలకు = 6 × 5%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   = 30 %

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            B యొక్క లాభం మొత్తం = 12000లో 30%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   = \\({30\\over100}×12000\\)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   = రూ. 3600 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            C యొక్క లాభాల శాతం 9 నెలలకు= 9 × 5%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    = 45%

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            C లాభం మొత్తం = \\({45\\over100}×15000\\) 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       = రూ. 6750 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            మొత్తం లాభం = 2500 + 3600 + 6750

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    = రూ. 12,850 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ∴ మొత్తం లాభం 12,850.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n286:T78c,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            दिलेल्याप्रमाणे:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            गुंतवलेली रक्कम,

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            A = 10,000 रुपये. 5 महिन्यांसाठी

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            B= 12,000 रुपये. 6 महिन्यांसाठी

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            C = 15,000 रुपये. 9 महिन्यांसाठी
